en: a person who has been hurt, killed or cheated, especially as a result of a crime or an accident; a person or animal that is killed as a religious offering
ex: The victim was taken to the hospital immediately.
受害者立刻被送往醫院。

en: a. usual, typical or expected; not strange; n. the usual state or condition of something; (math) the usual level
ex: His temperature is back to normal.
他的體溫已恢復正常。

en: n. a person whose job is to give advice on a particular subject; a teacher who gives guidance to students
ex: My academic adviser helped me choose my courses.
我的學業導師幫我選課。

en: n. a person who uses a product, machine or service; (informal) a person who regularly takes drugs
ex: The app is easy for new users to learn.
這個應用程式對新使用者來說很容易上手。

en: n. one of the two organs in the chest that you use for breathing; (in the plural) the ability to breathe or shout
ex: Smoking can damage your lungs.
吸菸會傷害你的肺。
ph: at the top of one's lungs

en: n. the inside part of the hand between the fingers and the wrist; a tropical tree with a tall trunk and long leaves growing at the top; v. to hide something in your hand; to take something secretly
ex: She held the small bird in the palm of her hand.
她把小鳥捧在手心。
ph: in the palm of one's hand

en: n. bread baked in a single large piece; a shaped block of something; v. to spend time doing nothing; to avoid work
ex: He bought a fresh loaf of bread from the bakery.
他在麵包店買了一條新鮮的麵包。
ph: half a loaf is better than none

en: v. to change from a solid to a liquid by heating; to make someone feel less angry or hard; to disappear slowly; n. melted snow or metal
ex: The snow began to melt as the weather got warmer.
天氣轉暖後雪開始融化。

en: a. happening or done once every week; n. a newspaper or magazine published once a week; adv. once a week
ex: We have a weekly meeting every Monday morning.
我們每週一早上有一次例行會議。

en: v. to choose someone for a job or position by voting; to choose to do something; a. chosen or elected but not yet in office; n. (the elect) a group of people chosen for special treatment
ex: The people will elect a new president next year.
人民明年將選出新總統。

en: n. a sudden loud noise; a heavy blow or hit; hair cut short in a straight line across the forehead; v. to make a sudden loud noise; to hit something hard; adv. exactly or directly
ex: The door closed with a bang.
門砰的一聲關上了。

en: n. a small piece of paper or cloth attached to something that gives information about it; a name or word used to describe someone; a game in which one person chases others; v. to attach a label to something; to follow closely behind someone
ex: The price is shown on the tag attached to the sleeve.
價格寫在袖子的吊牌上。

en: a. (informal) extremely good or great; very great in amount or degree; (old use) causing great fear
ex: We had a terrific time at the party.
我們在派對上玩得非常開心。

en: n. a group of sheep, goats or birds; a large number of people; v. to move or gather together in large numbers; to go to a place in large numbers
ex: A flock of birds flew over the field.
一群鳥飛過田野。
ph: birds of a feather flock together

en: n. a part of the sea that curves into the land; a long deep bark of a dog; a laurel tree; a section of a building; v. to bark loudly
ex: Fishing boats sail into the bay every morning.
漁船每天早上駛入海灣。

en: n. the part of a shirt, coat or dress that goes around the neck; a band put around an animal's neck; v. (informal) to catch someone and hold them; to take control of something
ex: He turned up the collar of his coat against the wind.
他把外套領子豎起來擋風。

en: a. having or showing a lot of energy and enthusiasm; involving a lot of physical activity
ex: The energetic children ran around the playground all afternoon.
精力充沛的孩子們整個下午都在遊樂場跑來跑去。

en: n. a large printed picture or notice that is put on a wall in a public place to advertise something; a picture that someone sticks on a wall for decoration
ex: There is a movie poster on the wall of her room.
她房間的牆上貼著一張電影海報。

en: v. to move slowly on your hands and knees with your body close to the ground; (of an insect) to move slowly; to move very slowly; n. a slow movement on hands and knees; a swimming style
ex: The baby crawled across the floor to reach the toy.
寶寶爬過地板去拿玩具。

en: to make someone or something weaker; to become weaker or less strong; to make something less powerful or effective
ex: The illness weakened him so much that he could hardly walk.
那場病讓他虛弱到幾乎走不動路。

en: a. more than what is already present or mentioned; added to something; extra
ex: Please bring additional copies of the report to the meeting.
請帶額外的報告影本去開會。

en: n. the air that goes in and out of your lungs; the act of breathing; a short time; a slight movement of air
ex: Take a deep breath and relax.
深呼吸，放輕鬆。

en: v. to pull something hard and quickly; to pull something along behind; n. a sudden hard pull; a small boat that pulls larger ships; a strong feeling or force that attracts someone
ex: The child tugged at his mother's sleeve.
孩子拉了拉媽媽的袖子。

en: n. an animal like a small horse with long ears; a stupid or stubborn person; (technical) a small steam engine
ex: The farmer rode a donkey to the market.
農夫騎著驢子去市場。

en: n. a very strong feeling of love, hate, anger or excitement; a strong enthusiasm for something; (the Passion) the suffering and death of Jesus Christ
ex: She has a passion for music and plays the piano every day.
她熱愛音樂，每天都彈鋼琴。

en: a. brave and willing to take risks; clear and noticeable; (of letters) in thick black type; n. text in a thick black type
ex: She made a bold decision to quit her job and start a company.
她大膽決定辭職創業。

en: n. a fine soft cloth made from the thread produced by a type of insect; the thread produced by silkworms; a. made of silk
ex: She wore a dress made of pure silk.
她穿著一件純絲綢的洋裝。

en: a. good enough; able to be agreed to or approved; allowed or tolerated
ex: Is this price acceptable to you?
這個價格你可以接受嗎？

en: to succeed in doing something good, usually after trying hard; to reach a goal; (achievement) something good that someone has done by their own effort
ex: She worked hard to achieve her dream of becoming a doctor.
她努力實現成為醫生的夢想。

en: n. something that helps you to be better or more successful than others; a good feature of something; a better position than someone else; v. to help or benefit someone
ex: Speaking two languages gives you a big advantage in the job market.
會說兩種語言讓你在就業市場上大占優勢。

en: v. to have enough money to buy or pay for something; to be able to do something without causing a problem; to provide or give something
ex: I can't afford a new car right now.
我現在買不起新車。

en: adv. at a later time; after something else has happened; after an event or time that has been mentioned
ex: We went to the movies and had dinner afterward.
我們先去看電影，之後吃了晚餐。

en: n. the science or practice of growing crops and raising animals for food; the business of farming
ex: Agriculture is the main source of income in this region.
農業是這個地區的主要收入來源。

en: n. a company that carries passengers and goods by air; a route followed by aircraft; a pipe for carrying air or gas
ex: She works for a major airline as a flight attendant.
她在一家大型航空公司擔任空服員。

en: n. a flat oval nut with a hard shell, eaten as a snack or used in cooking; the tree that produces this nut
ex: She sprinkled chopped almonds on the cake.
她在蛋糕上撒了切碎的杏仁。

en: n. the set of letters used in writing a language, arranged in a fixed order; the basic parts of something
ex: The English alphabet has twenty-six letters.
英文字母有二十六個。

en: to surprise someone very much; to make someone feel great surprise; (amazement) a feeling of great surprise
ex: The magician's tricks amazed the children.
魔術師的把戲讓孩子們驚嘆不已。

en: n. a spiritual being believed to live in heaven, often shown as a person with wings; a very kind and good person; a person who gives money to support a business or show
ex: She looked like an angel in her white dress.
她穿著白洋裝看起來像個天使。

en: to tell people something officially or publicly; to say something loudly or clearly; to introduce a person or program; (announcement) a public statement
ex: The airline announced a new flight to Tokyo.
航空公司宣布了一條飛往東京的新航線。

en: a. worried and nervous about something; wanting something very much or wanting to do something; causing worry
ex: She was anxious about her exam results.
她很擔心考試成績。
